metadata.description: Personal collection of AI agent skills, mostly for Claude Code.

plugins.name: oaat
plugins.description: Walk through pending decisions, questions, concerns and risks strictly one at a time, without overwhelming the user.

plugins.name: sitrep
plugins.description: Turn all open items, risks and concerns into a temporary visual HTML situation report (priority matrix, dependency map, cards), built for visual thinkers with ADHD.

plugins.name: milestones
plugins.description: A per-project milestone tracker (.cache/milestones.json) with a /milestones table, a progress bar and a colour statusline segment that shows what is left and who must act, and a Stop hook that nudges when the tracker is stale.

plugins.name: auto-commit
plugins.description: After each turn, tell the agent to snapshot uncommitted work in a Conventional Commit and keep the branch in sync with origin: merge only, no history rewrites, no .env files, no secrets.

plugins.name: block-force-push
plugins.description: Block git force pushes (--force, -f, --force-with-lease) before the agent runs them, and tell it to ask the user first.
